what: ComfyUI core's own Sol node (BlockSparseAttention, Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#16072) against ours (MiniMaxH3SolAttn), plus the owed all-rows sink pair, on three new scenes at two seeds (owner's ask, 2026-09-10). Every arm is the shipped 16-step t2va chain at 1344x768 and 345 frames with sage as the floor underneath; only the Sol node or its values differ.
policy: sage always on is the floor decision (docs/roadmap.md 2026-09-04). Three pairs per scene and seed: (A) ours as shipped vs core as shipped -- which node a stock user is better served by; (B) ours re-set to core's knob values vs core -- the implementation difference with the policy matched, which a render can show but not attribute (CLAUDE.md), so its attributing instrument is the capture grade planned beside it; (C) ours as shipped vs ours with sink_conditioning=exact_kv_and_all_rows -- the one-pair blind judgement roadmap step 3 owes, on three scenes instead of one.

scenes.courtroom: t2va_courtroom_verdict -- two-speaker cross-examination over a score, carved on-screen seal text, a silent judge: speech, lip sync and fine text
scenes.disco: t2va_disco_roller_rink -- a singer on quad skates with a lyrics pair, tracking shot, zoom and roll: fast motion, music and brightness under motion
scenes.hacker: t2va_cyber_hacker_den -- breach dialogue with stencilled on-screen text and screens: dense fine detail and text legibility

core_values: the oursc patches are h3_config.SOL_CORE_DEFAULTS translated to our node: tau 1.3, end_percent 1.0, token_aug 256 on all 50 DiT blocks (core applies extra_tokens to every eligible call, and only the 50 DiT calls clear min_tokens). start_percent 0.2, min_tokens 12288, sink exact_kv_and_rows and no dense blocks already match in the shipped graph. What cannot be matched is the implementation: core's chunked producer applies q/k-norm and RoPE inside the kernel and carries the previous step's K/V statistics (kitchen sol_attn_chunked); ours hands the kernel ComfyUI's normed, roped tensors and computes them per call

predictions.A: reasoned, not measured: core runs sparser (tau 1.3 against 1.0), routes the last step, and adds token routing on every block, which the 2026-09-04 grade found better on four captured blocks and worse on block 49 (docs/research/2026-09-04_sol_token_aug_grade.md). Expect no consistent winner across scenes on quality, and core slower per render (token routing on every call, kitchen #156's own claim)
predictions.B: can't-tell dominates: the knob values match and the remaining difference is numerical, which a matched seed turns into two samples; a consistent loss on one side across all six pairs would be the finding
predictions.C: same or can't-tell: on the probe the all-rows mode collapsed the text segment's error to the audio floor and moved video and audio by nothing the record resolves (bench/results/2026-09-04_sol_probe_subway_allrows_vs_shipped.json); a loss for all-rows on any scene is what would stop the switch

cost: 24 renders plus one warmup. Ours with sage underneath has been timed on the ladder (bench/results/2026-09-03_ladder_arms_judged.jsonl, the <scene>_sol rows); core's arm has never run here, so its time is whatever the first render says
